segments.text: A star's been acting weird since 1890. Still nobody's cracked why.
Twenty-two percent. Gone. In one shot.
A planet blocks maybe one percent, if you're lucky. This star just lost a quarter of its light — randomly, no pattern, nothing.
Naturally, the internet decided it had to be aliens. A literal megastructure, built to harvest the star's own energy.
So scratch the fun answer. The boring one? Still missing.
